scripts.build:pot: composer exec wp -- i18n make-pot . --exclude=build languages/fair.pot --headers='{"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To":"https://github.com/fairpm/fair-plugin/issues","POT-Creation-Date":""}'
scripts.lint:php: npm run cli -- composer run lint
scripts.lint:php:phpcs: npm run cli -- composer run lint:phpcs
scripts.lint:php:phpstan: npm run cli -- composer run lint:phpstan
scripts.format:php: npm run cli -- composer run format
scripts.format:php:phpcs: npm run cli -- composer run format:phpcs
scripts.format:php:phpstan: npm run cli -- composer run format:phpstan
scripts.test:php: npm run tests:cli -- composer run test
scripts.test:php:multisite: npm run tests:cli -- composer run test:multisite
scripts.coverage:php:single: npm run tests:cli -- composer run coverage:single
scripts.coverage:php:multisite: npm run tests:cli -- composer run coverage:multisite
scripts.coverage:php:full: npm run tests:cli -- composer run coverage:full
